entities.summary: Ayesha A. Malik is a Pakistani judge. She is the first female judge of the Supreme Court of Pakistan. On 6 January 2022, the Judicial Commission of Pakistan approved her appointment to the Supreme Court of Pakistan. She took her oath of office on 24 January 2022. Justice Ayesha has also served as a Judge of the Lahore High Court in Pakistan from 27 March 2012 to 5 January 2022.
